followup: Muse reported umask 0077. Codex reproduced both failures within a delegated cgroup at umask 0077, then restored the original fixture modes explicitly. All five releases tests pass in that same environment; the full Dashboard run also passes at umask 0077.
independent_claim: These are reported handoff results, not substituted for Codex or GitHub test results.
root_cause: fs.writeFile creation mode is filtered by umask: 0444 becomes 0400 at umask 0077. The unchanged immutable-artifact verifier correctly rejects the altered mode.
reproduce_command: cd dashboard && systemd-run --user --scope -p Delegate=yes --quiet env -u NODE_OPTIONS -u NODE_PATH sh -c "umask 077; node --test test/releases.test.mjs"
